title: 第1章 死亡或是新生第2章 异界大陆
content_zh:
“叮叮咚！”
放学的铃声响起，惊醒了在睡梦中的应无悔。
“终于下课了！
走吧墨瑀去店桥小吃街吃饭！”
“OK，走”
墨瑀收拾好书本，放入书包中。
许多同学跑的比他们还快，毕竟吃饭是大学生第一位。
校门口挤满了人，有的是出去玩，有的人和自己一样也是去吃饭。
店桥小吃街，街道错综复杂，有八九条线路，应无悔最爱吃沙县小吃是这里的常客，所以立马就冲进店去，叫了一份炒年糕，一份水煮饺。
“帮你点好了”
应无悔微笑道。
“嗯”
墨瑀不紧不慢。
“上次考试又挂了，又得补啊！”
应无悔烦闷道。
“让你平时不好好用功，又没办法，补呗”
墨瑀将水饺一个个放入嘴中。
应无悔学习不怎么样，和陌生人讲话也有些拘谨，上了大学之后，也没有改变现状。
但他会打工或兼职，也算勤奋老实人，学习理科很差，文科却还行，墨瑀则样样比他强。
“吃完了，哦！”

应无悔打了个响嗝。
“走吧，回学校”
墨瑀背起包，两人付完钱，推门而出。
“你还要买什么东西吗？”
墨瑀问。
“去超市买些水果吧”
应无悔潇洒地走在前面，墨瑀觉得很无语，走路就不能好好走些，这大街上这么多人。
拿起橘子香蕉袋，立马剥开一个沙糖桔，一根香蕉，左右开弓，一起吃下。
“来一点”
应无悔客气道。
墨瑀拿上两个沙糖桔，“说吧，怎么这么客气了？”
墨瑀一下子看破他那点小心思。
“哎呀，我是那种人嘛？晚上作业给我抄一下”
应无悔说道。
“行”
墨瑀同意。
哇，太棒了，作业？大学生有这种东西，除了吃饭睡觉玩耍，我觉得其它都多余了。
走在街道上，两人到了一个拐角处，只听到里面动静很大，似乎是有人在大叫，街道如此之吵，这点小声音自然很容易被盖过，两人立马反应过来，走到拐角深处，只看见一个青年小混混，全身花臂纹身，染着五颜六色酷炫的头发，钉着耳钉，手里拿着一把尖刀，正在恐吓威胁角落里的一个十来岁的姑娘，“把钱交出来，快点！”
青年小混混大声呵斥道。
“放开那个人！”

应无悔二话不说就上去直接开干。
“这小子太鲁莽了！”
墨瑀立马去大街上喊人来帮忙。
“你小子是找死吗？多管闲事！”
青年小混混恶狠狠道。
content_en:
"Ding ding dong!"
The school bell rang, waking Ying Wuhui from his sleep.
"get out of class is finally over!
Let's go, Mo Yu, to eat at Dianqiao Snack Street! "
"OK, let's go"
Mo Yu packed up the books and put them in his schoolbag.
Many students ran faster than them. After all, eating is the first priority for college students.
The school gate was crowded with people, some were going out to play, and some were going to eat just like me.
Dianqiao Snack Street is a complicated street with eight or nine lines. Ying Wuhui loves Shaxian snacks and is a frequent visitor here, so he immediately rushed into the store and ordered a fried rice cake and a boiled dumpling.
“I’ll order it for you.”
Ying Wuhui smiled.
"Hmm"
Mo Yu took his time.
"I failed the last exam again, so I have to make up for it again!"
Ying Wuhui said in annoyance.
"It's because you don't study hard and there's nothing you can do about it, so I'll make up for it."
Mo Yu put the dumplings into his mouth one by one.
Ying Wuhui wasn't very good at studying, and he was a little reserved when talking to strangers. After going to college, he didn't change his status quo.
But he can work part-time or part-time, and he can be considered a diligent and honest person. He is poor in science but okay in liberal arts. Mo Yu is better than him in everything.
"I'm done eating, oh!"
Ying Wuhui burped loudly.
"Let's go back to school"
Mo Yu picked up his bag, the two of them paid and pushed out the door.
"Do you want to buy anything else?"
Mo Yu asked.
“Let’s go to the supermarket and buy some fruit.”
Ying Wuhui walked in front of him gracefully. Mo Yu felt speechless. He couldn't walk properly because there were so many people on the street.
Picking up the orange and banana bag, he immediately peeled open an orange and a banana, spread them out and ate them together.
“Come on a little bit”
You should be polite without regrets.
Mo Yu took two sugar oranges and said, "Tell me, why are you so polite?"
Mo Yu suddenly saw through his little thoughts.
"Oh, am I that kind of person? Copy your homework for me tonight."
Ying Wuhui said.
"OK"
Mo Yu agreed.
Wow, great, homework? College students have this kind of thing. Apart from eating, sleeping and playing, I think everything else is superfluous.
Walking on the street, the two of them came to a corner and heard a lot of noise inside, as if someone was shouting. The street was so noisy, and the small sound was easily drowned out. The two reacted immediately, and when they walked deep into the corner, they saw a young gangster with tattoos all over his body, colorful and cool hair, earrings, and a sharp knife in his hand. He was threatening a teenage girl in the corner, "Hand over the money, hurry up!"
The young gangster shouted loudly.
"Let that man go!"
Ying Wuhui went up and started doing it without saying anything.
"This kid is too reckless!"
Mo Yu immediately went to the street to call for help.
"Are you looking for death? Mind your own business!"
The young gangster said fiercely.
